answer_1.quote: we propose a new dataset SportsVD which contains dialogue-video pairs on sports-domain events together with VCD, a novel multimodal dialogue generation method

answer_2.quote: We employ two aspects of automatic metrics to evaluate VCD and other baselines: • Relevance: we use (1) Rogue-L , ( ) BLEU , ( ) CIDEr and ( ) Meteor to evaluate relevance between candidates and reference. • Diversity: we simply use (1) Dist-1 and (2) Dist-2 to measure the diversity of candidates themselves.

answer_4.quote: Specifically, we randomly select 100 video-dialogue pairs from test set. The volunteer watches the video, reads dialogue context and rates corresponding candidates generated by VCD and other baselines.
answer_4.guideline: The volunteer is asked to rate the generated response from (0, 1, 2) in Fluency, Context-relevance, Event-relevance, Opinion-clarity, Knowledge-relevance, and Overall quality.
